Use an https:// address (plain http:// only for a server on this phone or your local network)
%1$s will be able to control this phone: see its screen, and tap, type, swipe and open apps for you. Only continue if you set this server up or trust it.
This disconnects the phone from %1$s, which it\'s paired with now. You\'ll confirm with your screen lock.
This link uses a developer token, which links can\'t set. Pair by scanning the QR code from your dashboard, or enter the token in the app.
This replaces the pairing with %1$s. The agent on %2$s will be able to see your screen and tap, type, swipe and open apps for you. Confirm it\'s you.
Enter the pairing token from your dashboard
That pairing link is not valid. Scan the QR code again.
Lets the agent see the screen and tap, type and swipe for you.
Switch greyed out or says \"Restricted setting\"?
Android blocks this switch for apps installed outside the Play Store until you allow it once:
Tap the ⋮ menu in the top-right corner.
Tap \"Allow restricted settings\" and confirm with your PIN or fingerprint.
Come back here, tap \"Open Accessibility settings\", then Installed apps › OpenMob › On.
Needed for the always-visible \"agent active\" notification, which also has a Disconnect button.
Allow OpenMob to control this phone?

OpenMob uses Android's Accessibility service so the AI agent on the server you paired with can:

• See what is on your screen (screenshots and on-screen text)
• Tap, type, swipe and open apps on your behalf

This only happens while you are connected, and a notification is shown the whole time. Screen contents go only to your own server. OpenMob never types passwords or PINs.

You can disconnect any time from the notification, and turn this off again in Settings › Accessibility.

On the next screen, tap OpenMob (it may be under "Downloaded apps" or "Installed apps") and turn it on.

Offers screen sharing the first time someone opens this phone\'s live view, so your dashboard shows smooth video (Android asks each time you connect). Off: the dashboard shows a few screenshots a second and never asks.
Smooth live view is off. Turn it on under Connection any time.
Pair with your agent server first.
Accessibility is off, so the agent can\'t see or control the screen yet.
Tell your phone what to do…
The agent will leave this app and start from your home screen.
No speech recognizer is installed on this phone.
Nothing yet. What your agent hears, does and says shows up here.
Disconnect any time from the notification. OpenMob never types passwords or PINs.
On your computer, open your dashboard › Connect a phone, and scan the QR code with this phone\'s camera.
Your agent will no longer be able to control this phone. To use it again, scan a new code from your dashboard.
This phone is no longer paired.
Sign in to your OpenMob account. This phone keeps only its own key, never your sign-in.
The agent on this server will be able to see your screen and tap, type, swipe and open apps for you while you\'re connected. Only continue if you started this.
For your security, OpenMob only pairs on phones with a screen lock (PIN, pattern, password or fingerprint), so only you can approve an agent. Set one up in Settings, then scan the code again.
Pairing cancelled. Scan the code again when you\'re ready.
Generate a new code on your dashboard and scan again.
Pair this phone first: scan the QR code on your dashboard.
OpenMob agent can control this phone
Asks you before your agent buys, sends or deletes something.
%1$s is asking. Tap Review to approve with your screen lock.
Approving needs your screen lock, so the AI using your phone can\'t approve this itself. If you didn\'t expect this, deny it.
Not approved. Tap Approve to try again, or Deny.
Approving needs a screen lock (PIN, pattern, password or fingerprint). Set one up in Settings, or deny this request.
This request was already answered or has expired.
Not connected to your agent, so the answer wasn\'t sent. Reconnect and try again.
Let OpenMob run in the background
Without this, Android may cut the connection when the screen is off, and your agent loses the phone mid-task.
OpenMob can run in the background.

Android pauses apps in the background to save battery, which would cut your agent off mid-task when the screen is off. OpenMob only keeps a small connection open while you\'re connected, and does nothing once you disconnect.
Android blocks this for apps installed outside the Play Store. Allow restricted settings first (steps below).
No \"Allow restricted settings\" in the menu? Try turning OpenMob on in Accessibility once first; Android adds the option after that.
Notifications are off, so approval requests show here only.
Agents would ask you less on this phone. This needs your screen lock. If you didn\'t ask for this from your dashboard or an app you trust, deny it.
Approving lets your agent carry out these steps. Anything risky that isn\'t in the plan, and any payment, will still ask you. To change the plan, deny it and type what to change in the chat.
This phone can\'t approve yet. Update the OpenMob app and reconnect; until then you can only deny.
This request doesn\'t match the action it describes, so it can\'t be approved. Deny it.
This phone has no approval key (it goes away if the screen lock is removed), so it can\'t approve. Reconnect or pair again to approve; you can still deny.
%1$s You can turn it off any time in the dashboard\'s phone settings.
Don\'t ask: agents act without asking until %1$s

Agents would act without asking on this phone, and could also buy, pay and subscribe with your saved payment methods until this ends. This needs your screen lock. If you didn\'t ask for this, deny it.
Agents could make purchases on this phone without asking you until Don\'t ask ends. Blocked apps stay blocked. Only allow this if you trust what\'s driving the phone.
Agents will ask you again on this phone.
No laptop? Sign in on this phone
Samsung: also add OpenMob to \"Never sleeping apps\"
Background usage limits › Never sleeping apps › + › OpenMob
Share the screen for the live view
Someone opened this phone\'s live view. Share the screen to show it as smooth video; Android asks again each time you connect.
Screen sharing is on for this connection.
Show this screen on your dashboard?
Tap to share it as smooth video. Until then the live view shows screenshots.
This phone stopped the agent to ask you. The question and the picture come from what this phone sees, not from the server. Approving needs your screen lock and allows this one action only.
Your agent paused because the phone locked. It carries on when you unlock it.
The phone locked mid-task. Unlock it to continue.
Your answer is needed on the phone
